source_ref: Centro de Investigaciones Sociologicas (CIS), Estudio n 3130 'Actitudes hacia la cooperacion internacional (II)', February 2016 (2,453 interviews). Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/actitudes-hacia-la-cooperacion-internacional-ii- ; microdata deposit https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556286/MD3130.zip (md5 c13ec6ab4d285f5f395f78d5b8f9bef6) containing fixed-width DA3130 and SPSS syntax ES3130 (VARIABLE LABELS and VALUE LABELS); questionnaire https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556286/cues3130pdf.pdf (byte-identical to cues3130.pdf inside the zip), P.10, P.12, P.17. Processing script data/spain_2016_cooperation.do, Bookmark 3: awareness. Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the CIS syntax file ES3130 in MD3130.zip ties each source column to its question -- VARIABLE LABELS P10 'Conocimiento de la reduccion por la crisis de los fondos destinados a la ayuda al desarrollo', P12 'Conocimiento del objetivo de los paises industrializados de dedicar el 0,7% de su PIB para ayudar a paises menos desarrollados', P17 'Conocimiento de los Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible de Naciones Unidas para 2030' -- and its VALUE LABELS tie the codes to item-specific anchors: P10 1 'Si, lo sabia' 2 'Es la primera noticia que tiene' 9 'N.C.'; P12 1 'Si lo conoce' 2 'No, es la primera noticia' 9 'N.C.'; P17 1 'Si, conoce o ha oido hablar' 2 'No, es la primera vez que oye hablar de ello' 9 'N.C.'. The shipped item_text is the full question wording of P.10, P.12 and P.17 transcribed verbatim from the questionnaire (read from the -layout pdftotext rendering; the non-layout rendering interleaves the two-column page and wrongly places P.12's options under P.10, so it was not used), and the option_text is the questionnaire's printed options, which agree character-for-character with the value labels. Anchors differ by item, so options are item-specific rows. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do file infixes DA3130 at the ES3130 column positions (p10 col 47, p12 col 49, p17 col 57, identical in ES3130's DATA LIST) and does gen item = the literal variable name, so the IRW code IS the source column name lowercased -- Step 5b exempt. CHECKED ANYWAY, decisively: reading DA3130 at those positions and dropping code 9 as the .do file does reproduces the live item x resp counts cell for cell -- p10 1:1448 2:996, p12 1:1312 2:1135, p17 1:859 2:1579 (source code-9 counts 9/6/15; 2,453 records). Live per-item n from irw::irw_table_sets() server-side: 2444/2447/2438, total 7329 rows; the item x resp table came from the locally cached copy table_context.R had already fetched, no new export. The three n are mutually distinct and the 1/2 splits differ sharply (p17 is the only item with a 'No' majority, as expected for the least-known of the three facts), so every item is distinguished from every other and the resp direction is confirmed. text_source=study_materials: Spanish from CIS's own questionnaire and syntax labels. translation_source=machine_translation: the English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW; CIS publishes no English version of this questionnaire. instructions and section_prompt blank, one trivial section_id: the three are standalone questions with no shared carrier text (the questionnaire's opening greeting is a generic interview introduction, not framing for these items). Step 3b: the dictionary Description (awareness of aid cuts, the 0.7 percent GDP target and the UN SDGs) matches P10/P12/P17 exactly; no instrument mismatch. Siblings from the same study (interest, duty, funding) are separate tables and were not touched. RIGHTS: no block. The wording's originator is CIS, a Spanish public body; its reuse conditions (fetched 2026-09-23, page sha256 d3d7aff1c79d97c271974e460f0776523c81cc06902048ec7c07e23261aec99b) grant a positive right: 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilizacion de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'La reutilizacion autorizada incluye, a modo ilustrativo, actividades como la copia, difusion, modificacion, adaptacion, extraccion, reordenacion y combinacion de la informacion'. Conditions are attribution, non-alteration and no claim of official status, none a reserved right of the irw#1945 kind. No instrument_rights_register.csv row written.
public_note: Each question also had a 9 'N.C.' (no answer) code that the IRW processing script drops to missing; the English in the _translated columns was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only.

source_ref: Centro de Investigaciones Sociologicas (CIS), Estudio 3130 'Actitudes hacia la cooperacion internacional (II)', fieldwork 20-29 February 2016, N=2453. Microdata package https://www.cis.es/documents/d/guest/md3130 (ES3130 SPSS syntax: variable and value labels; DA3130 fixed-width data; cues3130.pdf questionnaire P.5 col (41) and P.13 col (50)). Processing script data/spain_2016_cooperation.do (Bookmark 2: duty). Reuse terms https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: md3130.zip ships ES3130, CIS's SPSS syntax, whose variable labels tie each column to its question -- P5 'Deber de Espana de cooperar internacionalmente para ayudar a los paises menos desarrollados', P13 'Deber de dedicar Espana el 0,7% de su PIB a ayudar a paises menos desarrollados' -- and whose value labels give P5 1 Si / 2 No / 3 '(NO LEER) No estoy seguro/a' / 8 N.S. / 9 N.C. and P13 1 Si / 2 No / 8 N.S. / 9 N.C. Derivation: data/spain_2016_cooperation.do reads DA3130 with infix positions copied from ES3130 (p5 col 41, p13 col 50) and sets item = the lowercased source variable name, so the codes ARE the CIS variable names; the questionnaire prints the same column numbers (41) and (50) beside P.5 and P.13. Because the positions are hand-typed, it was checked against the data (verify_spain_2016_cooperation_duty.R): applying the .do file's sentinel rules to DA3130 gives p5 1942/245 (n 2187) and p13 1657/359 (n 2016), reproducing the live table cell for cell (per-item n via irw_table_sets; per-level from the locally cached copy). text_source=study_materials: item_text and option_text transcribed verbatim from cues3130.pdf (P.5 and P.13 question text and read-out options), cross-checked against pdftotext of the same PDF in both layout and raw modes. P.13 opens with '¿Y' because it follows P.12 (awareness of the 0.7% target) in the questionnaire; kept as administered. No shared carrier text, so instructions is blank. translation_source=machine_translation: the English in the _translated columns was written by IRW; CIS publishes this questionnaire only in Spanish. RESP: live set 1,2. P5's code 3 '(NO LEER) No estoy seguro/a' (volunteered, not read aloud; 207 of 2453 respondents, 8.4%) is dropped by the .do file along with 8/9, so no option row is shipped for it; P13 has no such code (its 419 N.S. are dropped as missing). Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Whether Spain has a duty to help less developed countries and to dedicate 0.7 percent of GDP to development aid' matches P5+P13; no mismatch. RIGHTS: no block. The wording's originator is CIS, a Spanish public body; its reuse conditions page (fetched 2026-09-23, sha256 33d0951f84076566488e14812f7d6fb31d586eedc88618af067028da56ef8e14; the batch_293 fetch of the same URL hashed differently, the page carries dynamic markup, but the operative text is unchanged) grants rather than reserves: 'permiten la reutilizacion de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'cesion gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual ... autorizandose la realizacion de actividades de reproduccion, distribucion, comunicacion publica o transformacion'. No register row written (a round may not write a ship row). Siblings: md3130 / cues3130.pdf also cover spain_2016_cooperation_awareness, _funding and _interest; only P5/P13 were extracted here.
public_note: The English item and response-option wording for this table was produced by IRW, not by CIS, which publishes this questionnaire only in Spanish; the administered Spanish is in the base fields. For p5, respondents could also volunteer 'No estoy seguro/a' (not sure; CIS code 3, not read aloud, 8.4% of the sample), which the IRW processing script treats as missing, so only Si (1) and No (2) appear in the data

source_ref: Centro de Investigaciones Sociológicas (CIS), Estudio 3130 'Actitudes hacia la cooperación internacional (II)', 2016. Study page https://www.cis.es/es/estudios/actitudes-hacia-la-cooperacion-internacional-ii-; microdata https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556286/MD3130.zip (ES3130 SPSS syntax variable+value labels, DA3130 fixed-width data, cues3130.pdf P.20); processing script data/spain_2016_cooperation.do Bookmark 4: funding.
note: mapping_basis=data_labels: the CIS microdata package MD3130.zip (https://www.cis.es/documents/20117/1556286/MD3130.zip, md5 c13ec6ab4d285f5f395f78d5b8f9bef6) ships the SPSS syntax file ES3130, whose VARIABLE LABELS read /P2001 'Comunidad autónoma' and /P2002 'Ayuntamiento' and whose VALUE LABELS read 1 'Sí, dedica algo' 2 'No dedica nada' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.' for both. The questionnaire cues3130.pdf (same package; md5 3abc680453c2e2aa6d7c37f4c3153f54, identical to the study-page cues3130pdf.pdf) prints P.20 as a two-column grid headed 'Comunidad Autónoma' (70) and 'Ayuntamiento' (71), and those card-column positions are exactly the infix positions ES3130 and data/spain_2016_cooperation.do assign to P2001 (col 70) and P2002 (col 71) -- two independent ties of code to text at the source. Derivation is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do reads DA3130 with infix using the ES3130 names (lowercased) and sets item = the column name, so p2001/p2002 ARE the source columns; nothing positional beyond the published column layout, Step 5b exempt, no verification/verify_*.R written. CHECKED ANYWAY, no export: reading columns 70 and 71 of DA3130 (2453 records) gives P2001 1:771 2:203 8:1477 9:2 and P2002 1:532 2:330 8:1581 9:10; applying the .do's filter (8/9 to missing) leaves n=974 and n=862, and irw::irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE) returns exactly 974 (p2001) and 862 (p2002), n_rows 1836. The two n are distinct, so a swap of the two items is excluded by the data. text_source=study_materials: item_text uses the questionnaire's column headers (capitalised 'Comunidad Autónoma' as printed in cues3130.pdf; the ES3130 label is lowercase 'autónoma'); instructions is the full P.20 question verbatim; option_text is the questionnaire/.sav anchors verbatim. section_prompt blank, one trivial section_id. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3130 in Spanish only; the four _translated columns were produced by IRW. RESP SET: live {1,2}; 8 'N.S.' and 9 'N.C.' dropped to missing by the .do, so no option rows for them. CAVEAT (see public_note): N.S. is the MODAL answer -- 1477/2453 (60.2%) for the Comunidad Autónoma and 1581/2453 (64.5%) for the Ayuntamiento -- so the live table covers only the ~38%/35% who claimed to know; for a question framed as '¿Sabe Ud. si...' the dropped category is substantive, not noise. Step 3b: dictionary Description 'Belief that the respondent's autonomous community and municipality dedicate resources to development cooperation' matches P.20 exactly; no instrument mismatch. Siblings from the same study (interest P1/P201-P208, duty P5/P13, awareness P10/P12/P17) not touched. RIGHTS: originator is CIS itself; instrument_rights_register.csv already carries a Ben-ratified CIS row (verdict 'allow', 2026-09-22, scoped to spain_2025_* but naming the CIS originator); I applied it to this 2016 CIS study rather than re-deriving, and re-read the clause: https://www.cis.es/es/condiciones-reutilizaci%C3%B3n-datos-del-cis fetched 2026-09-23 still states 'Las presentes condiciones generales permiten la reutilización de los documentos sometidos a ellas para fines comerciales y no comerciales' and 'Esta autorización conlleva, asimismo, la cesión gratuita y no exclusiva de los derechos de propiedad intelectual' (page sha256 e6faf8b5441f1379b7f2fdc836e78efa908943a64a8ce6b9ac49820d028d6b34; the register notes this page has no stable hash). Conditions are attribution/no-distortion only. No register row written; the orchestrator may wish to widen the CIS row's scope to spain_2016_*.
public_note: The English wording in the _translated columns was machine-translated by IRW from the Spanish CIS administered; note also that 'N.S.' (don't know) was the most common answer to this question (60% for the Autonomous Community, 64% for the town council) and the IRW processing script drops it to missing, so the response table holds only the respondents who gave a yes/no answer.
